Analyse the ALDER site only, from the three immutable local pilot sources, and persist your analysis as exactly evidence-alder.md.

Step 1 — Source inventory. Use file_list to see the workspace, then file_read ONLY these three files: sources/pilot-charter.txt (S1), sources/weekly-observations.txt (S2), sources/reviewer-note.txt (S3). Read nothing else. Never write to, move or modify those three files.

Step 2 — Extract every Alder-relevant fact: the Alder request total and site-weeks, Alder delayed-acknowledgement count, Alder supervisor escalations, the definition of a delayed acknowledgement, the acknowledgement timing figures (baseline manual median and pilot routed median) and how acknowledgement is measured, the pilot window and scope, the weekday-only limit, the Depot exclusion, the runbook change, the reviewer sampling and reconciliation, and the reviewer's caveats and recommendation as they bear on Alder.

Step 3 — Write evidence-alder.md with:
(a) An attribution header naming you as the child analyst, your role (researcher), and the three sources read.
(b) An Alder fact table or bullet list where EVERY factual or numerical claim carries an inline citation in exactly the form [S1], [S2] or [S3], placed after the claim. No uncited factual claim.
(c) A short 'Discrepancies and open questions' section. If any two sources disagree, or a figure is implied rather than stated, record it with citations instead of resolving it by assumption. Do not silently reconcile anything, and do not invent a number that no source states.
(d) A closing scope note that your evidence is limited to the weekday Alder pilot and supports no weekend or Depot conclusion.

Step 4 — Persist. Call file_write to create evidence-alder.md in the workspace root, then call save_artifact with mission_id='r2-final-professional-2026-11-16T20-21-29-437Z-3269230-research' and name='evidence-alder.md'.

CRITICAL: A text-only reply fails. A reply in chat is not an artifact and the coordinator cannot re-attribute your prose to you. The deliverable exists only when you have written and registered evidence-alder.md yourself.
